purpose: Synthetic developer-authored provenance diagnostics. No real articles, checked citations, independent annotations or pilot gold labels are represented.
label_policy: Exact means nonempty whitespace-normalized matching text. Near means a constructed wording copy without a material scope/number change, including substantial paraphrases the lexical detector may miss. Explicit means a shared identifiable report reference or direct citation in these fixtures. Group means a diagnostic relationship is warranted, not that independence or exclusive reliance is proven.

cases.rationale: Identical text and the same document URL.

The synthetic sensor recorded a steady temperature during the test.

cases.rationale: Different domains do not make identical passages independent.

cases.rationale: A shared publisher label and host are metadata signals, not a reason to merge unrelated articles.

cases.rationale: Inserting not materially changes the assertion despite high wording similarity. Do not group on this similarity alone.

The synthetic inspection report states that the laboratory is not safe for routine operation under the documented procedures and the standard equipment checks completed by trained technicians during the annual review of the facility.

cases.rationale: Institution attribution alone does not identify a shared original report.

cases.rationale: Different passages from one document share source identity even when wording differs.

cases.rationale: Repeated titles can refer to different editions/documents; no unique identifier was supplied.

The "Demo Survey" report concerns instrument maintenance.

cases.rationale: Meaningful query parameters must not collapse distinct article identities.

cases.rationale: A subscription link is not an original evidence report.

cases.rationale: One snippet explicitly cites the other document. This does not establish endorsement.

cases.rationale: Shared institution mentions must not transitively combine three sources.

cases.rationale: Pairwise citations permit overlapping AB and BC groups, but not an unsupported AC relationship or ABC cluster.
